name: jianying-edit
description: Native, fully editable JianYing Pro drafts from jy14-headless plans or compiled edit-plans, driven through the user's jianying-headless fork unmodified: multi-track video/text/audio with transitions, keyframes, masks, narration condensing, and native MP4 export. Pinned to macOS JianYing 11.4.x.

interface.shortDescription: Edit-plan JSON to native JianYing drafts
interface.longDescription: Generate native, fully editable JianYing Pro drafts from jy14-headless plans or compiled edit-plans, driven through the user's jianying-headless fork unmodified: multi-track video/text/audio assembly with transitions, keyframes, masks and narration condensing, hash-pinned engine components, build/verify/publish discipline, and native MP4 export. Drafts open in 剪映 as normal projects for fine-tuning and in-app export.
